details.description:
Pediasure 7+ is a specialised nutritional drink that provides complete balanced nutrition for growing children 7 years and above. Scientifically designed with various vital nutrients along with the goodness of oats and almonds to support height gain, strength improvement, and brain development. With high-quality protein, Pediasure offers optimum nutrition to children 7 years and above to maximise growth and strength during the period of second growth spurt. Bones can grow up to 1.5 times from 7 to 14 years.
Pediasure 7+ is specifically formulated with essential nutrients like zinc, iron, iodine, protein, calcium, and vitamin D to support this growth and height gain. Children engage in various day-to-day activities that require physical strength. Along with a healthy diet, Pediasure 7+ helps in meeting nutritional requirements in 7+ children. This nourishing nutrition drink supports bone strength with key nutrients all known to improve bone mineral density and muscle mass. Pediasure 7+ also offers crucial nutrients like folic acid, vitamin B12, zinc, iron, and iodine to support brain development. Kids like the taste. This specialised nutritional drink is available in chocolate and vanilla flavours.
